s: Din hammapsiq kede lebarek ubo g' seipim: shelosha sheakelu keachat vegameru [shenayim] seudatam veechad lo gamar — haechad mapsiq al korcho lehashshenayim veoneh immahem birkat hazzimmun, veshomea ad "hazzan et hakkol", kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g. Veim lav — hu lo yatza yede chobat zimmun. Abal hem mezammenin alayv ben oneh ben eno oneh, kol shehu omed sham veshomea veyakol laanot. Veim eno omed immahem — qorin lo ad sheyyitqareb alehem veyukal lishmoa velaanot immahem, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"d (mah sheen ken becheresh sheeno yakol lishmoa veillem sheeno yakol laanot — en mezammenin alehem ella baasara, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"t):

Abal shenayim enan chayyabim lehapsiq leechad. Lepikak, en chiyyub zimmun chal alehem kelal ad sheyyitratztzu lehapsiq laechad ulebarek. Veim lo ratzu lehapsiq vezimmen hu alehem velo anu acharayv, o shello shameu ad "hazzan et hakkol" — lo asa kelum velo yatza yede zimmun. Lepikak, ap hu eno rashshay lebarek ad sheyyigmeru hashshenayim seudatam vizammen alehem, shehare kebar nitchayyeb bezimmun mittechillat hasseuda im hitchilu sheloshtam yachad, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g. Veim nitratztzu lehapsiq lo vezimmen alehem veachar kak ba echad min hashshuq veqaba immahem vegameru seudatam immo — enan chozerin umezammenin, shekkebar parach mehem zimmun keshezzimmenu paam rishona. Abal echad hammapsiq lishnayim veachar kak bau shenayim min hashshuq veqabeu etzlo vegamar seudato immahem — chozer umezammen immahem, shehu naasa tapel lishnayim ellu shello zimmenu adayin, kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"g. Vehu haddin paam b' veg' o yoter, yakol lehapsiq ulezammen im kol shenayim shebbau veqabeu etzlo veakal immahem kezayit. Vehu haddin im hayu tisha qebuim yachad mittechilla vehipsiq echad lishnayim mehem — yakol [ha]echad lachazor ulehapsiq lishnayim acherim mehem, velachazor ulehapsiq lishnayim, abal shenayim haacharonim parach zimmun mehem keshezzimmenu harishonim, velo nishar zimmun bachabura im lo sheakelu od achar zimmun harishonim, kemo shennitbaer sham besiman qtz"g, vesham nitbaaru kol perate dine "parach zimmun":

Hammapsiq lezimmun en tzarik lachazor ulebarek "hammotzi" keshechozer lisudato, sheen kan hepseq vehessach haddaat kelal, ki gam bishmiato birkat "hazzan" hayeta kavvanato leekol od veshello latzet bibraka zo. Ulepikak, im achar kak nimlak shello leekol od — tzarik lachazor ulebarek birkat hammazon. Abal im lo haya bedato leekol od pat raq parperet — yatza yede chobat birkat "hazzan", umatchil birkot hammazon mibbirkat haaretz. Umikkol maqom, yizzaher shello ya[si]yacha benetayim, veachar birkat hammazon yebarek meen g', shehi beraka acharona al happarperet, shehi mechameshet hamminin, ki lo niptera bebirkat hammazon, hoil velo berak bah birkat "hazzan". Veim achar sheyyatza yede chobat birkat "hazzan" nimlak lachazor veleekol pat — tzarik littol yadayv ulebarek "hammotzi" techilla, shekkebar asa silluq vehessach haddaat beborko beraka achat mibbirkat hammazon (abal hessach haddaat lebaddo eno zaquq lebarek "hammotzi", kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"t):
